name: claude-sub
summary: Claude subscription (anthropic, fleet CLI aliases haiku/sonnet/opus) builds: optional, uses your Claude plan, not the init default. Reviews through omp, the default agent, with Gemini (google, GEMINI_API_KEY) and then Gemini through OpenRouter (OPENROUTER_API_KEY). Check needs CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set.
